verdict.rationale: Orrick's own Tech Studio publishes at least some jurisdiction-specific startup material: a German incorporation questionnaire and a European Startup Health Check. Nothing in the pack shows publications on market-specific equity instruments or rules such as UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules or French BSPCE. The global equity compensation offering is an advisory service, not published guidance. Missing for 10: any evidence of published content on EMI, VSOP, BSPCE or Indian FDI/ESOP rules; depth of jurisdiction-specific articles and guides; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE

citations.quote: Our European Startup Health Check gauges your company’s readiness for the next phase of growth.
